changelog:
Discord presence handles pausing properly now: while an episode plays you get the live progress bar, and the moment you pause, the bar is replaced by the elapsed time at the paused position — no progress bar keeps creeping forward while nothing is playing.
Resuming re-anchors the bar to the real playback position instead of continuing from where the paused timer had drifted, and an item without a known duration keeps the plain elapsed timer while it plays.
The option's description in Discord settings now states both halves of that behaviour.
message: Dev build v867 - progress bar while playing, elapsed time while paused
